name: aetheros
description: Local-first agent runtime that refuses unsourced claims by default and turns every failure into the next skill.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aetheros/core run build && pnpm --filter @aetheros/cli run build
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:policy && pnpm lint:css && pnpm check:icons && pnpm check:fonts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:offline && pnpm verify:demo
